claim_scope: ACWM-Phys reference-instance mechanism ablation only. This study does not establish cross-backbone transfer.

selectors.projection_contract: paired baseline outcome mean and variance; no intervention response
unaligned finite-dose outcome deltas; no uncertainty or path mask
one-sided local response coordinates, covariance, locality residual, and supported-path mask

matched_trial_contract.candidate_pool: identical settled-confirm primitive candidates within each target fold

label_contract.source: settled official confirmation receipts or explicit retained-checkpoint completion-gate receipts
label_contract.positive: all official validity checks pass and the frozen aggregate delta is positive
label_contract.negative: settled null or harmful confirm receipt

launch_policy.gpu_confirmation_may_start_when: every target fold has a non-leaking settled candidate pool
launch_policy.formal_claim_requires: all eight held-out folds and all three seeds use settled official-gate receipts
